_help: OPTIONAL FILE. With only a SimpleFIN connection the ledger needs no personal.json at all. Every key below is optional and independent: copy just the sections you want to ~/.config/wealth-ledger/personal.json (chmod 600), replace the values with your own, and leave the rest out. Keys starting with _ are comments. Each section's _help says what it is for and what else it needs.
_simplefin_only: Useful without a spreadsheet: account_kinds, credit_limits, rules, dashboard (default_username, theme, ledger_start, web_connect), subscriptions, overdraft, rental, inherited_ira, backup, simplefin_watch. Needs the gws CLI signed in to Google: sheet_id and everything that reads the sheet (networth, home, cars, crypto, budget, amazon, networth_history), zelle_memos (Gmail) and monthly_email (Gmail).
_sheet_id: Optional. A Google Sheet with a hand-kept 'balance sheet' tab (assets the feeds can't see: cash, metals, home, cars) and an 'income sheet' budget tab. Remove this key for a ledger of synced accounts only.
_auto_kind: Optional key "auto_kind": true or false. true = each new account's type is guessed from its name at every sync. Default: true without sheet_id, false with it (you classify accounts yourself).

account_kinds._help: Optional. An account's type when the name doesn't say it, or the guess is wrong: account_name LIKE pattern (as the Accounts card shows it; % matches anything) -> checking, savings, credit, investment, retirement, hsa, loan, crypto or custodial. The longest matching pattern wins. Only checking, savings, credit, investment, retirement, hsa and loan accounts count toward net worth: custodial is someone else's money, and crypto is counted through the spreadsheet's crypto total, so without a spreadsheet give an exchange wallet you want counted the type investment. Takes effect on the next sync.

networth._help: Optional; needs sheet_id. Balance-sheet tab labels (column A, exact). synced: label -> account_name LIKE patterns (as shown in v_accounts) whose live balance replaces the sheet value.

credit_limits._help: Optional. Card credit limits for cards whose feed reports none (Plaid sends its own; SimpleFIN never does): account_name LIKE pattern (as shown in v_accounts) -> limit in dollars. Takes effect on the next sync.

_rules: Optional. How a transaction is classed when the built-in rules (ctdb.py BASE_RULES) get it wrong: [priority (lowest wins), description LIKE pattern, account type or null, "in"/"out" or null, class, note]. Classes: spend, income, refund, transfer, card_payment, investment. Only spend counts as spending and only income as income. Takes effect on the next sync.

home._help: Optional; needs sheet_id. valuations/home.py: a monthly estimate of your home's value for the balance-sheet row named in asset.
home.cad_note: appraisal-district market value as of Jan 1

cars._help: Optional; needs sheet_id. valuations/cars.py: a monthly estimate of each car's value from comparable listings.

odometer: where the odometer reading came from
cars.sanity: optional note, e.g. a dealer trade-in estimate

crypto._help: Optional; needs sheet_id (the sheet's crypto tab). Wallet addresses and exchange keys go in crypto_wallets.json next to this file. exchange_rows: wallets that have their own balance-sheet row (only coins the crypto total counts are counted there). ignore_coins: coin symbols left out altogether, in every wallet (no row, no value, no warning), e.g. a reward token held as dust that has no price and would otherwise warn 'no price for <wallet> <coin>, not counted' at every sync.

dashboard._help: Optional. default_username: the name set-password uses when none is given (default admin). ledger_start: first day of complete transaction data; spending before it is not shown (default: everything). web_connect: true lets a signed-in viewer paste a SimpleFIN setup token on the page while nothing is connected yet (for a second person's ledger). exact: networth.py line label -> category; rules: [regex, category] fallbacks tried in order. Categories: cash retirement taxable crypto metals realestate vehicles other. theme: the colour theme (all dark) for browsers that haven't picked one in the page footer: graphite (default), rose, amethyst, plum or sage.

budget._help: Optional; needs sheet_id. exclude_categories (not shown here): regex of budget categories that are saving, not spending. insights/budget.py: [transaction regex on 'payee | description', budget-line regex on 'category/item' of the 'income sheet' tab]; tried before the generic defaults in budget.py. Put your landlord, utilities and people you pay here.

amazon._help: Optional; needs sheet_id and imported Amazon orders. points_band (not shown here): [lo, hi] discount fractions for orders part-paid with card points, default [0, 0.15]. insights/amazon.py: [item regex on 'department | product name', budget-line regex on 'category/item' of the 'income sheet' tab] for Amazon order items; tried before the generic ITEM_RULES. Put rules for your own hobbies, properties or brands here.

inherited_ira._help: Optional; the card is hidden without this section. insights/inherited_ira.py (dashboard 'Inherited IRA'). account: v_accounts name LIKE pattern (default: BDA/INHERITED/BENEFICIARY). Facts: death_year of the original owner, owner_started_rmds true/false (null = unknown), your beneficiary_birth_year, optional owner_birth_year, growth_rate for the plan, optional year_end_balances {"YYYY": balance} when no Dec 31 snapshot exists, optional manual_distributions [{date, amount}] for withdrawals from before the bank feed's history.

rental._help: Optional; the card is hidden without this section. insights/rental.py (dashboard 'Rental property'): income and expenses of a rental from your transactions. match: category -> description/payee LIKE patterns (bookings, rent, other_income, mortgage, cleaning, software, utilities, insurance, repairs, other); a pattern may be {"pattern": ..., "direction": "in"|"out", "kinds": [...]}. exclude: patterns that are never the rental. Also: start (first day counted), mortgage_account (LIKE on the loan's account name), defaults: false to drop the built-in booking-site rules.
rental.label: Rental property

subscriptions._help: Optional. insights/subscriptions.py: regexes for recurring charges that are bills (kept apart from cancellable subscriptions) beyond the built-in list.

monthly_email._help: Optional; needs the gws CLI signed in to Gmail. insights/monthly_email.py: last month's summary from the ledger database (no spreadsheet), emailed once a month by the daily sync on or after 'day'. Off unless enabled is true. Sent with gws from the signed-in Gmail to itself; 'to' names another address. categories: [transaction regex on 'payee | description', category], tried before the generic defaults.

plaid._help: Optional; only read when plaid.json exists (plaid/plaid_sync.py setup). The user id sent to Plaid Link.

networth_history._help: Optional; needs sheet_id. insights/nw_history.py (dashboard trend before the daily snapshots): Drive name of your yearly balance-sheet spreadsheets, each named '<name_query> YYYY' with a 'balance sheet' tab (dated columns, a 'Total Equity' row).

zelle_memos._help: Optional; needs sheet_id and the gws CLI signed in to Gmail. insights/zelle_memos.py: Gmail search for your bank's Zelle emails (default: zelle)

overdraft._help: Optional. insights/overdraft.py (dashboard 'Upcoming drafts & pay') works without it. ends: a recurring bill's last possible draft day (description LIKE pattern -> YYYY-MM-DD), e.g. the end of a lease; nothing is projected for it after that day.

backup._help: Optional. bin/wealth-ledger-backup (run after each daily sync): gzipped copy of the database into dir, which should be on a different disk and must already exist. Keeps keep_days of dailies plus every 1st-of-month copy. Leave out to turn backups off.

simplefin_watch._help: Optional. bin/simplefin-institution-check (run it from cron monthly): search SimpleFIN's institution list for these queries; ignore maps a query to the exact result that is already known.
simplefin_watch.label: the account you are waiting for
